roles.adminDescription: Full access, including users, libraries and server settings.
roles.managerDescription: Can edit tags, upload, rename and delete files.
roles.downloadDescription: Can download original files and albums.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Who can sign in to Rainy and what they may do.
users.createDescription: They can sign in with this username and password — also from Subsonic apps.
users.deleteDescription: Their playlists, favorites and play history are deleted too. Music files are not touched.
users.selfAdmin: You can't remove your own administrator role.
users.selfDelete: You can't delete your own account.
users.resetHint: Share it with them securely; they can change it in their settings.

validation.usernameInvalid: Use letters, digits and . _ - @ + only (no spaces).

libraries.title: Libraries & scanning
libraries.subtitle: Music folders Rainy indexes, and their scan status.
libraries.dialogDescription: A folder on the server that contains music.
libraries.deleteDescription: Its tracks are removed from Rainy's database (with plays and favorites). The files on disk stay untouched.
libraries.emptyDescription: Add the folder that contains your music.
libraries.pathHint: The path as the server sees it — in Docker that's the path inside the container, e.g. /music.

settings.title: Server settings
settings.subtitle: Settings for everyone using this server.

help.scanInterval: How often to look for new or changed files.
help.fixEncodingOnScan: Show GBK / Big5 / Shift-JIS tags correctly. Files are not modified.
help.genreSeparators: Characters that split one genre tag into several.
help.ignoredArticles: Words skipped when sorting artists (“The Example Band” under E).
help.coverArtFiles: Folder images used as album covers, in priority order.
help.transcodeFormat: Used when a client asks for a lower bitrate.
help.enableDownloads: Users with the download permission can save original files.
help.renamePattern: Used by Rename / organize and uploads with “Organize by tags”.

validation.duration: Use a duration like 30m or 6h (0 turns it off).
validation.pattern: The pattern needs at least one token like {title}.
